scope: Resolve a pre-outcome inconsistency between the main prospective protocol and the barrier-field implementation contract.

conflict_detected.main_protocol: docs/GLOBAL_MONTE_CARLO_BARRIER_ATLAS_PROTOCOL.md specifies that complete classifiable colour vectors are permuted within species while coordinates, sampling schedules and graph geometry remain fixed.
conflict_detected.older_field_contract: docs/supporting/global_monte_carlo_barrier_field_contract_v1.json specified permutation of rank-standardized edge scores within species.

primary_null_after_amendment.unit_permuted: complete photograph-level soft four-group colour vector
primary_null_after_amendment.permutation_scope: one species-conditioned photograph-colour assignment per null replicate, reused across the exact same frozen outer species/photo schedule
fixed: spherical kNN graph geometry for each outer realization
recomputed_after_each_permutation: soft four-group Jensen-Shannon divergence on every fixed graph edge
primary_null_after_amendment.p_value: (1 + number of null G1 concentrations >= observed G1 concentration) / 1000

reason: Graph edges sharing a photograph are statistically dependent because the same colour vector contributes to multiple edges. Permuting already-computed edge scores destroys that node-sharing dependence and is not equivalent to the species-conditioned photograph-label null used in the prior spatial analyses. Photograph-level vector permutation preserves the intended exchangeability unit.
edge_score_shuffle_status: legacy diagnostic only; forbidden as the primary G1 null and forbidden as a rescue null
supersedes: Only the null.shuffle item of docs/supporting/global_monte_carlo_barrier_field_contract_v1.json; all non-conflicting field, support and stability rules remain frozen.
